verdict: CP-REPRESENTATION-REWRITE REMAINS TOUSSAINT-SPECIFIC. One substrate with an H2 measurement and unmatched arms. Every other implementation either lacks the phenotype-preserving property, lacks the measurement, or lacks matched arms. Answer to directive question 12: DO NOT PROMOTE.
